The read also says little about her race or what comes next, apart from asking which race she wants and whether the Thanksgiving 10K is still on. That's a fair question, but it leaves the 10K plan undecided. A short explanation of why she's waiting and roughly when speedwork could start would answer her more fully.

Recent weeks: 42, 46, 34, 41 mi
This week: 12 mi over 3 runs.
Body: "Legs came back by Thursday. Blister healed."
Feeling: "Itching to train again."
Asks: "I feel ready. Can I go back to 40 miles next week and start speedwork for the 10K?"
